Trinity Business School Global Excellence Postgraduate Scholarships 2026 is an initiative by Trinity College Dublin, the University of Dublin, for postgraduate applicants. This scholarship aims to support the study of full-time postgraduate students. The selected students will receive a scholarship between €2,000 and €5,000 as a reduction in their tuition fees for the first year of study only.
To be eligible, an applicant must:-
be taking admission to a full-time postgraduate course at Trinity Business School for the academic year 2026/2027
Note:- The candidates must be able to pay tuition fees at the non-EU rates.
The selected students will receive up to EUR 5,000 (5,57,990) as a reduction in their tuition fees for the first year of study only.
Note - The applicants must have received a conditional or firm offer of a place in a Trinity postgraduate course.
Eligible candidates can apply for the scholarship by following the steps mentioned below -
Click on the 'Apply Now' button below.

If already registered, log in using Gmail/Mobile number/Email ID).
Step 4: Fill in the mentioned details and proceed with the application.
